newsitem.title: UK: BT calls Sunday news conference at 1300 GMT.
newsitem.headline: BT calls Sunday news conference at 1300 GMT.

text.p: British Telecommunications Plc said on Saturday that it had scheduled a news conference for 1300 GMT on Sunday following an earlier announcement that it was in merger talks with MCI Communications Corp.

The spokesman said he could not say what the meeting would be about, only that it would be in connection with recent developments. The news conference would be held at BT's Central London headquarters.
But he said BT expected to put out a news release on Sunday morning.

MCI said on Friday it was in talks to be acquired by BT, which already has 20 percent in the company. Analysts were speculating on a price of $40 a share, which would value MCI at $28 billion and leave BT with a 22.1 billion bill for the 80 percent it does not own.
The two companies had promised a further statement prior to markets opening on Monday.
